More than a recipe.
A memory of home.

Bundelkhand’s food tells its story through grains, lentils, seasonal greens and recipes passed around family kitchens.

Bundeli Mart brings these flavours together: the comfort of maheri, the savoury bite of thopa, and sweets made for sharing.
